name: sled full hack squat
description: A hack squat on a sled machine through a full range of motion, loading the quads and glutes.
instructions: Set your shoulders under the pads and your feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Unlock the safety and straighten your legs.
Lower your hips slowly until your thighs are below parallel.
Keep your back flat against the pad and knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your whole foot to stand back up.
